bug_semantics: The Time Series Visual Builder (TSVB) metrics visualization server API accepts an authenticated user's panel/metric JSON and evaluates response processors against the resulting row objects. getSiblingAggValue() reads nested properties with the attacker-influenced path `${metric.id}.${key}` through lodash _.get(); _.get silently traverses __proto__/constructor.prototype segments, and the surrounding processor code writes computed values back into shared objects. A crafted metrics payload to the visualization API endpoint therefore modifies Object.prototype (CWE-1321 prototype pollution); polluted prototypes cascade into gadget execution on the server, yielding arbitrary code execution.
flaw_origin: Commit 4f3e625d7fa69034e3a74ac222792aba3025436c ("Time Series Metric Visualizations (#9725)", 2017-03-02, author Chris Cowan) is the initial import of the TSVB plugin and created src/core_plugins/metrics/server/lib/vis_data/helpers/get_sibling_agg_value.js with the exact vulnerable line `return _.get(row, `${metric.id}.${key}`);` — the attacker-influenced _.get path that the 2025 fix replaces with safeGet. The parent tree (7cbc22b052a28a1e5340a0fa58b27500e2495c87) lacks src/core_plugins/metrics entirely, so the vulnerable helper is written by this commit. Later commits (d891623f/9c9fb17f 2017 sibling-agg consumers, 91dc30e6 2018 core_plugins move, e3c08f76 2019 tsvb rename, 0a324476 2020 new-platform move) are pure relocations/consumers of the same 8-line helper, not origins.
